title: Prose data-sheet extractor (Wave B)
description:
Add a deterministic regex/labeled-block extractor for the ~35% of high-value data that lives in semi-structured prose rather than tables — repeated `Label: value` blocks like `Address:`, `Founded 1966`, `Contact:`, `Travelift:` in marina and club histories (files 16, 17, 55, 67, 69) and owner narratives (15, 74). Detect labeled-field clusters, extract into the same node/edge model via the existing mappers/entity-resolution, and link to the yachts/regions already created in Wave A. No LLM — pure pattern matching with a documented set of field patterns. Rows that cannot be confidently parsed are logged to a `skipped/` report for a future LLM pass, never guessed.

Part of Phase 1 (Ingestion). Deterministic-first; LLM recall pass is explicitly deferred to a later milestone.
acceptance_criteria: Labeled-block extractor pulls Marina/YachtClub/Person fields from prose files 16, 17, 55, 67, 69 into nodes via the shared mappers
Extracted entities are deduped against Wave-A nodes (no duplicate Marina/Region/Person for the same real-world entity)
Unparseable blocks are written to a skipped-report file (count + source location) instead of being dropped silently or guessed
Field-pattern set is documented in code so it can be extended
Tests cover at least one marina data-sheet and one club-history block with expected field extraction
